$comment: The address book for PHARN's own 'specified; ships with the guarded surface' annotations.
Read by .dev/floor/check-specified-markers.mjs. STRUCTURED on purpose (lessons-learned L6): a
membership fact is read from here, never by scanning doc prose for what looks like a marker.
ADDING AN ENTRY is what makes a new annotation guarded. Nothing discovers annotations; this file
is a hand-maintained list, so an unlisted overclaim is invisible to the checker. Stated in the
checker's header as its central limit.
